    SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS cnt 
    FROM EMP
)
SELECT 
    T2, 
    COALESCE(SUM(EXPR0), 0) 
FROM (
    SELECT 
        1 AS T2, 
        cnt AS EXPR0 
    FROM total
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT 
        2 AS T2, 
        cnt AS EXPR0 
    FROM total
) t
GROUP BY T2

original_query: SELECT t0.JOB, t1.NAME FROM (SELECT EMPNO, ENAME, JOB, MGR, HIREDATE, SAL, COMM, DEPTNO, SLACKER, DEPTNO + EMPNO AS f9 FROM EMP WHERE ENAME = 'A') AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPTNO, NAME, DEPTNO + 5 AS f2 FROM DEPT) AS t1 ON t0.JOB = t1.NAME AND t0.f9 = t1.f2 GROUP BY t0.JOB, t1.NAME
rewritten_query:
SELECT emp.JOB, dept.NAME
FROM emp
LEFT JOIN dept 
  ON emp.JOB = dept.NAME 
  AND (emp.DEPTNO + emp.EMPNO) = (dept.DEPTNO + 5)
WHERE emp.ENAME = 'A'
GROUP BY emp.JOB, dept.NAME;

original_query: SELECT t2.SAL, t2.EXPR1, t5.EXPR2, t9.EXPR3 FROM (SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t2 INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, AVG(COMM) AS EXPR2 FROM (SELECT SAL, COMM FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL, COMM) AS t4 GROUP BY SAL) AS t5 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t5.SAL INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, SUM(SAL) AS EXPR3 FROM (SELECT SAL FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t8 GROUP BY SAL) AS t9 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t9.SAL
rewritten_query:
SELECT t2.SAL, 
       t2.EXPR1, 
       t5.EXPR2, 
       t9.EXPR3 
FROM (SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1 
      FROM EMP 
      GROUP BY SAL) AS t2 
INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, AVG(COMM) AS EXPR2 
            FROM (SELECT SAL, COMM 
                  FROM EMP 
                  GROUP BY SAL, COMM) AS t4 
            GROUP BY SAL) AS t5 
ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t5.SAL
INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, SAL AS EXPR3 
            FROM EMP 
            GROUP BY SAL) AS t9 
ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t9.SAL

original_query: SELECT * FROM EMP LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DEPT) AS t ON EMP.DEPTNO = t.DEPTNO ORDER BY EMP.SAL FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
rewritten_query:
WITH top_emp AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM EMP 
    ORDER BY SAL 
    FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
)
SELECT top_emp.*, t.* 
FROM top_emp 
LEFT JOIN DEPT t ON top_emp.DEPTNO = t.DEPTNO
ORDER BY top_emp.SAL

original_query: select * from emp where empno > ANY (  select deptno from dept where emp.job = dept.name);
rewritten_query:
SELECT e.*
FROM emp e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dept d
    WHERE e.job = d.name
    AND e.empno > d.deptno
)

original_query: select deptno c, min(y), max(z) z, sum(r), sum(m) n, sum(x) sal from (    select deptno, ename, sum(sal) x, max(sal) z,       min(sal) y, count(hiredate) m, count(mgr) r    from emp group by deptno, ename) t group by deptno
rewritten_query:
SELECT deptno AS c,
       MIN(y) AS "MIN(Y)",
       MAX(z) AS z,
       SUM(r) AS "SUM(R)",
       SUM(m) AS n,
       SUM(x) AS sal
FROM (
    SELECT deptno, 
           ename, 
           SUM(sal) AS x, 
           MAX(sal) AS z,
           MIN(sal) AS y, 
           COUNT(hiredate) AS m, 
           COUNT(mgr) AS r
    FROM emp 
    GROUP BY deptno, ename
) t 
GROUP BY deptno
